FN-WDPBE55-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 169
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/30/2024
Senate Bill 169 as introduced would increase the financial obligations of the Education Trust
Fund by an undetermined amount annually to expand benefits provided by the Alabama G. I.
Dependents’ Scholarships Program to certain eligible dependents to cover post-bachelor and
graduate studies in a medical field with no caps on tuition, books, and instructional fees for
these dependents and extend the timeframe by which certain eligible dependents of partially
disabled veterans can receive benefits by an additional 2 years.

FN-WDPBE55-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 169
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/30/2024
Senate Bill 169 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education would
increase the financial obligations of the Education Trust Fund by an undetermined amount
annually to expand benefits provided by the Alabama G. I. Dependents’ Scholarships Program
to: (1) include graduate studies effective January 1, 2025; (2) extend the timeframe by which
certain eligible dependents of partially disabled veterans can receive benefits by an additional 2
years; and (3) extend the timeframe certain dependent children have to initiate the educational
benefits by an additional four-years.
